changes.title: Pending preference edits
changes.text: The inactive sync model no longer marks a newer edit or deletion as acknowledged when only an older same-millisecond update was accepted.

changes.title: Acknowledgement regressions
changes.text: Added same-millisecond edit, deletion, tombstone replacement, device identity and save/reload acknowledgement checks.

changes.title: Verified delivery and hourly evidence
changes.text: Recorded TEST111 delivery and published the owner's hour-by-hour evidence PDF without rebuilding the app or inventing work time.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I corrected acknowledgement handling in the future preference-sync model and retained its pending edits across restart. Online functionality remains inactive; current gameplay and raw history are unchanged.
